description: Demo xMB template: broadcast a live HLS stream over MBMS. One Application session in Pull mode -- the BM-SC fetches the HLS manifest + segments and FLUTE-delivers them. IMPORTANT: the entry-point URL points at the local hls-http-proxy (start it first: node hls-http-proxy.js), because the BM-SC's libcurl+GnuTLS cannot pull RTVE's TLS1.3/HTTP2 CDN directly. Load, then Activate the session in the portal's xMB tab.
